summary: Implemented ClauseAnalysisPage (UC4) with all 14 owned components: ClauseListPanel, ClauseDetailDrawer, ClauseEditBox, AcceptSuggestionControl, MandatoryClauseFlagBadge, OverallRiskScoreLabel, ContractMetadataPanel, AskAIBox, UnsupportedFileBlocker, AIExtractionFailureBanner, AccessDeniedBanner, ConcurrentEditConflictModal, ProceedToNegotiationButton and AuditLogViewer, wired to the 9 contracted /api/v1/lifecycle endpoints via a new lifecycleClauseAnalysisService.js, a clauseAnalysisSlice zustand store, and one hook per contracted hook name. Role gating (LEGAL_REVIEWER full edit, CONTRACT_OWNER accept/ask-only, TENANT_ADMIN read-only, others denied) and the four screen states (unsupported file, extraction-failure, access-denied, populated) are all implemented and covered by src/__tests__/ClauseAnalysisPage.test.jsx. Lint, build and the full test suite (30 tests) pass. Verified visually against IMG-1/IMG-2 by running the page against a local fixture server at 1440x900 as both TENANT_ADMIN and LEGAL_REVIEWER — header actions, the Overall Contract Risk Score banner with flag chips, the 5-stat row, clause rows with category/match-status/mandatory badges, the clause detail drawer (AI Explanation, Suggested Text, Accept/Edit/Reject), the Contract Metadata panel with AI-suggested/User-confirmed labels, the Mandatory Clause Check panel with progress bar, and the Ask AI box all match the target design's layout, copy and color language.

code_files.description: Typed client for the /api/v1/lifecycle clause-analysis, accept-suggestion, clause edit/reject, metadata, ask-ai, proceed-to-negotiation, retry-extraction and audit-log endpoints.
Zustand slice matching the clauseAnalysisSlice contract: contractId, clauses, overallContractRiskScore, metadata, proceedToNegotiationEnabled.
Fetches the clause list, overall risk score and metadata for a contract and syncs the store.
Calls accept-suggestion and returns the updated ClauseResponse.
Saves a manual clause edit and exposes a conflict flag on 409 responses.
Submits a clause rejection.
Saves manual edits to contract metadata fields.
Submits a free-text question and returns the AI answer with disclaimer.
Routes the contract to UC5 once mandatory clauses are resolved.
Retries AI clause extraction after a failure or timeout.
Fetches the paged immutable audit log for a contract.
Grid of extracted clauses with Clause Category, Library Match Status, mandatory badge and risk score, plus All/Flagged tabs and the 5-stat summary row.
Expanded clause detail with AI Explanation, Suggested Text, and the Accept/Edit/Reject controls.
Free-text area for manual clause rewrite with Save action, carrying expectedVersion for the concurrency check.
One-click Accept Suggestion button, disabled for Missing clauses and for roles without accept rights.
Red 'Mandatory clause missing' badge, shown only for mandatory clauses whose Library Match Status is Missing.
Banner showing the Overall Contract Risk Score and summary flag chips.
Editable Parties/Contract Value/Start/End Date/Renewal/Payment Terms/Key Obligations fields with AI-suggested/User-confirmed labels.
Free-text question input with empty-question validation and the AI Answer Display carrying the verification disclaimer.
Blocking message for unsupported file formats.
Retry / Continue Manually banner for AI extraction failure or timeout.
Full-screen permission-denied message for roles outside Legal Reviewer/Contract Owner/Tenant Admin.
Blocking modal for the 409 concurrent-edit conflict, prompting a refresh.
Proceed to Negotiation button, enabled only when proceedToNegotiationEnabled is true.
Read-only slide-over listing the paged immutable audit trail.

Route-level page assembling the header, risk banner, clause list/detail, metadata panel, mandatory clause check, Ask AI box and all alternate-flow states; role-gates editing per BR-9/BR-10/BR-11/BR-12.
Screen-level tests covering populated render, Proceed-to-Negotiation disablement, unsupported-file blocking, access denial, and the extraction-failure banner.
Added the /contracts/:contractId/clause-analysis route for ClauseAnalysisPage.

pr.title: feat(lifecycle-uc4): add AI Clause Analysis page
pr.body: Implements ClauseAnalysisPage and its 14 owned components for UC4 (AI Clause Analysis): clause list/detail/edit, accept/reject, mandatory-clause flagging, overall risk scoring, editable contract metadata with AI-suggested/User-confirmed labelling, Ask AI, proceed-to-negotiation gating, audit log viewer, and the unsupported-file / extraction-failure / access-denied / concurrent-edit alternate flows. Wired to the 9 /api/v1/lifecycle endpoints via a new service module, store slice and one hook per contracted hook. Lint, build and tests (30 total, 5 new) pass; visually verified against the target design at 1440x900.

blockers: Inferred fields not explicitly listed in context.json's DTOs but required by the TARGET DESIGN and derivable from named fields already in the contract: none required — all design elements (clause row category/status/risk, mandatory badge, metadata labels, mandatory-check counts) map directly to fields already declared on ClauseResponse and ContractMetadataResponse (e.g. mandatoryClauseFlagLabel, partiesLabel, isMandatory). The only values computed client-side rather than read from a field are: the 5-stat clause-list summary (counts derived from clauses[].libraryMatchStatus) and the Mandatory Clause Check progress bar (matched/total derived from clauses[].isMandatory + libraryMatchStatus) — both are pure aggregations of already-typed fields, not invented data.

UC4-AF-002 (continue manually after AI extraction failure) asks the user to be able to manually tag Clause Category, Library Match Status, Risk Score, Mandatory Clause Flag etc. for clauses, but this module's endpoint contract has no POST-clause / create-clause endpoint — only PUT (edit an existing clause), accept-suggestion and reject on clauses that already exist. 'Continue Manually' is implemented as dismissing the failure banner (clauses/metadata remain whatever came back, typically empty) rather than letting the user author brand-new clause rows, since fabricating a create-clause endpoint is out of scope per CLAUDE.md. Metadata editing and Ask AI remain available in this mode, consistent with the DTOs that do exist.

UC4-AF-004/UC4-BR-006 require that a blocked (second) concurrent save write NO audit log entry, and that only the successful first save is recorded. Audit log writing is entirely server-side (the audit-log endpoint is GET-only); the frontend cannot violate this invariant since it never writes directly to the audit log, but equally cannot verify server behavior from the client — flagging this as outside frontend-testable scope.

The ProceedToNegotiationResponse DTO returns negotiationStatus/clauses/metadata but there is no NegotiationTrackerPage route in this task's scope (it belongs to a separate screen/task per the module contract). On a successful proceed-to-negotiation call this page shows an inline success message with the returned negotiationStatus instead of navigating to UC5, since that route does not exist yet in this codebase.

AuditLogViewer's trigger and placement (a header 'Audit Log' button opening a right-side slide-over) is a judgement call: neither IMG-1 nor IMG-2 shows this surface, and the components contract gives it no page-layout hint beyond 'read-only viewer'. Implemented as an on-demand overlay rather than an always-visible panel to avoid crowding the two-column layout the design does show.

Role-based editing (canEditClauseText = Legal Reviewer only per endpoint-role table for PUT .../clauses/{clauseId}; canReject = Legal Reviewer only per POST .../reject; canAccept/canAskAI = Legal Reviewer + Contract Owner; Tenant Admin fully read-only) follows the endpoint contract's roles column rather than the design screenshots, which do not indicate which role is viewing. Verified visually as both TENANT_ADMIN (Edit/Reject hidden, Accept disabled) and LEGAL_REVIEWER (all controls present) against the target design.
